report:
Reviewed the complete alias identity claim and all seven ordinary implementation associations, both ordinary tests, and the explicit TODO test. Requirements are: one semantic family for named/associated/opaque aliases; stable definition identity and type arguments across stash copying, folding, display, inference, canonical queries/responses, and oracle emission; debug formatting must not serve as semantic identity.

Representation: ty.rs uses Ty::Alias and the three AliasTy variants. Named and opaque payloads store TypeAliasSymbol plus type argument slices; ProjectionTy additionally stores associated definition, Self, trait definition/arguments, and item arguments. These are semantic symbols and typed child nodes, not debug strings. Derived stash allocation/copy support operates on this representation. The ordinary copy/fold/display test constructs all three with real symbols, distinguishes variants, checks all display spellings, and now directly asserts copied definitions and argument types, including associated Self and trait identity/arguments. Associated substitution checks preserved definition and trait identity and Bool substitution into Self, trait, and item arguments. ty_fold.rs explicitly rebuilds each alias variant with its original definition and recursively folded argument slices. display.rs formats semantic names and recursively formats children without modifying the semantic value.

Inference: skeleton.rs distinguishes named/associated/opaque rigid heads by symbol and arity; associated heads also retain trait symbol and separate trait/item argument counts, while decomposition/recomposition preserves ordered children. unify.rs traverses these children for occurs/universe checks. The ordinary test asserts the named-alias occurs check and universe leak errors. This is meaningful partial inference coverage, not a complete inference identity fixture matrix.

Canonical queries: canonical.rs preserves each alias tag, symbols and ordered child fields while mapping inference variables to alpha parameters. Responses: boundary.rs extraction and import copy every variant structurally, preserving definition symbols while translating children and binder/inference variables. The roundtrip test directly checks Named definition identity and one argument at canonicalization, extraction, and caller import, an alpha parameter inside the canonical and response aliases, retained alias shape, the imported inference-variable child, and the root-universe constraint. Associated/opaque canonical paths are inspected structurally; this representative Named end-to-end test does not claim an exhaustive variant matrix.

Oracle: emit.rs explicitly maps rustc free/projection/inherent/opaque alias kinds to structured Type::Alias values with normalized definition and recursively emitted type arguments. Its fallback debug primitive arm is not used for alias kinds; it is not a semantic alias representation. The explicit sage_meta::todo::types_aliases_identity entry remains justified and retained: complete inference identity and independent oracle fixtures still need to be built before those aspects can be called fully tested. In particular, rustc-vs-Sage fixtures must expose retained alias outputs rather than only already normalized concrete types; inference fixtures must exercise identity-sensitive equality for every family. No placeholder is being counted as ordinary behavioral coverage.

Captured additional dependency context includes inference unification, test database/root setup helpers, review policy, and the associated-type-normalization rationale. Essential helper files now carry this anchor's own implementation associations so future changes invalidate the assessment. No production behavior changed. Strengthened assertions address evidence precision, not a reproduced runtime bug. Commands actually executed: cargo fmt; cargo test -p sage-test-harness alias_variants_copy_fold_and_display_without_erasing_identity -- --exact trait_solver_boundary_tests::alias_variants_copy_fold_and_display_without_erasing_identity (one test passed); cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib aliases_round_trip_through_canonical_query_and_response_stashes (one test passed). Full workspace build and delegated post-codegen/sanity reviews are centrally coordinated by root, not claimed here. All current entries are accounted for, with inference/oracle deferrals visibly TODO.
